caption: The drawing depicts a single andiron, consisting of a tall, central vertical shaft with a bulbous, black center section that tapers toward the top and bottom. At the top of the andiron is a gold-colored, ornate finial, shaped with facets and surmounted by a twisted flame-like ornament. The base of the andiron is black and composed of three curved legs extending outward and downward, ending in flat, rounded feet. Projecting backward from the lower section of the shaft is a horizontal, black support bar with multiple segments. On the left side of the drawing, there is a simplified line diagram of the andiron, rendered in pencil, that shows the same shape but without color or shading; beneath this diagram is a short scale marked in inches. The artist's name, Hans Korsch, is written in the bottom right corner. The background is plain, with a light beige or off-white color, and a thin rectangular border encloses the drawing.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
